title: Find it, typed
hints: `newest` only needs one thing from its items: a numeric `createdAt`. Put that in a constraint, `<T extends { createdAt: number }>`, and return `T | undefined` so the caller keeps their type.
`findBy` needs two type parameters: the item type `T`, and a key `K extends keyof T`. The value must have the same type as that field. That's `T[K]`.
function findBy<T, K extends keyof T>(items: readonly T[], key: K, value: T[K]): T | undefined { return items.find((item) => item[key] === value); }
